title: Venezuelan Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla, filled with melty cheese and a hint of Venezuelan spice.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining quesadillas and cheese.
Cut into wedges and serve hot with a sprinkle of charred Venezuelan spice blend.
